{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u051/system/state/workspace/programs/task-5d041bc0.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # The most frequent color is the background. Count the horizontal objects
    # of each other color, then encode each color as that many cells.
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objects = Counter()
    for row in grid:
        i = 0
        while i < len(row):
            if row[i] == background:
                i += 1
                continue
            color = row[i]
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(row) and row[j] == color:
                j += 1
            objects[color] += 1
            i = j
    cells = []
    for color in sorted(objects, reverse=True):
        cells.extend([color] * objects[color])
    cells = (cells + [0] * 6)[:6]
    return [cells[:3], cells[3:]]
"
}
